features.title: Native CLI custody and the modernized client presentation
acceptance: Theme style offers Orbital Dark and Orbital Light without changing preset IDs, and the motion-scale token scales animation durations.
Desktop navigation is four floating apps, with Plugin Management and Skill Hub on the Agent detail page and Chat Channels in Mobile Pairing.
An Execution process viewer with search, copy, step-through and live follow replaces inline process cards, and an accepted dispatch shows its waiting treatment until the first real reply text.
Loading animation is a persisted setting: a simple spinner by default, a static indicator, and the previous conversation particles as an opt-in that alone keeps anchor measurement and glyph sampling.

licoup is the documented local CLI facade, one biometric authorization covers all selected Gateway keys through LicoUpCustody.app, and the MCP allowlist is five tools with lico-conversation-mcp removed.
Migrate legacy keys moves Gateway credentials to the Data Protection Keychain without re-entering them.
DeepSeek Harness is a first-class agent, and Claude Code pickers list the real model catalog.
Group conversations bind to their own recorded history through store schema 14 to 15.
Startup stages around the Local conversation, and large replies and long-running commands no longer block the UI or the native host.
Removed the Kimi Desktop target; Kimi Code CLI is unaffected.
evidence: PR #338 required Branch flow, Commit identity, Auditor, Client source policy, Flutter checks, Rust checks and the Client required aggregate passed on the exact head.
The stable edge's client gate builds and installs the macOS arm64 client, then observes the installed app's bounded survival proof.
